propositions: Changing ticket_type after plan-review attestation causes a stale verdict to be replayed instead of re-running the review under the new type's criteria.
Both idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse reuse paths gate on material_fingerprint and code SHA but never compare ticket_type, allowing incorrect verdicts when a ticket is retyped.
Plans that PASS when typed as bug (exempt from multiple scoring criteria) incorrectly retain that PASS verdict when retyped to task (not exempt) and re-reviewed via reuse.
The fix compares stored ticket_type against current type in both reuse paths and returns None to force re-review on mismatch, while preserving reuse when either value is absent or empty (fail-open).
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type, so the fix requires no schema change and no modification to material_fingerprint.
End-to-end verification confirmed that retype from task to bug now triggers a fresh LLM run instead of replaying the stored verdict.
